patch_description: This version restructures feature engineering into a modular, regime-aware pipeline with three layers: short-horizon market state, rolling z-scored local context, and compact interaction features. It replaces many long-memory absolute indicators with shorter lookbacks and rate-of-change features, which should be more stable across regime shifts. The model is also made more conservative with stronger regularization and smaller trees to reduce regime-specific overfitting while preserving prediction spread. The external inputs/outputs and `run_experiment()` interface remain unchanged.
